name: Closed-Loop DPCM Decompression
definition: Decompresses a CompressedTraceBlock using closed-loop DPCM. Reads bit depth from payload. Falls back to legacy decoder if payload is not closed-loop.
summary: Closed-loop DPCM decompression reconstructs seismic data using a feedback loop to prevent error accumulation, distinguishing itself from open-loop methods by supporting variable bit-depths and robust error handling.
